meta.subject: fix regression issues on base config

en.summary: This mixed regression-fix commit includes a real execute-path bug: mesh operand valids were incorrectly gated by peer-channel conditions, so operations that did not need all operand streams could stall or be suppressed. It also re-enables loop store-address progression and fixes optional external-memory guards.
why_it_counts: ExecuteController and LoopMatmul contain concrete DUT behavior fixes rather than tests or documentation changes.
The mesh valid gating change directly alters when the array accepts operands.
The store-address update fix repairs looped store progression in hardware control state.
disqualifiers: The commit also contains option-handling and plumbing fixes for configurations without an external TL memory writer.
Multiple bugs are bundled together, so the cleanest injection target is only one part of the patch.
evidence: ExecuteController removes n_a_r_not_v, n_b_r_not_v, and n_d_r_not_v from mesh.io.a.valid, mesh.io.b.valid, and mesh.io.d.valid.
Under the old logic, a channel could be blocked when a peer channel was inactive but ready, because the peer predicate became false.
LoopMatmul re-enables the st_c_addr_start update when a store request fires.
Scratchpad, Controller, and AccumulatorMem add option-aware guards around ext-mem and TLB resources for the base configuration.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: The primary reusable bug is in a controller that can launch several operand streams toward a compute array in the same cycle. The broken version made each operand-valid depend on the state of other operand channels, even when those peer channels were not required for the current operation. That turns independent operand streams into an accidental coupled handshake and can suppress legal launches or create pipeline stalls whenever only a subset of operands should move.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: An operation launches one or two operand streams while another peer stream is inactive, empty, or otherwise not part of the current issue slot.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Reintroduce peer-channel predicates into each operand valid so that a channel is only marked valid when unrelated sibling channels satisfy extra ready/valid conditions.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: gate each valid with peer-channel state instead of only local fire and local data availability
portability_notes: This maps to any systolic-array, vector-lane, or fused-operator front end with more than one independently sourced operand stream.
The fault is architecture-level: make one operand stream wait on another stream that is not semantically required for the same cycle.
If your DUT lacks three channels, inject the same class of bug between any two partially independent operand inputs.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the combinational logic that drives per-operand valid signals into the compute array or operand collector.
Add extra predicates derived from sibling-channel ready or buffered-data state to each valid signal, even when those sibling channels are not required for the current operation.
Keep local payload data unchanged so the bug manifests as suppressed launches or unnecessary stalls rather than data corruption from a different source.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: ExecuteController mesh input valid logic, with LoopMatmul store-address progression as a secondary bundled fix
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix removes cross-channel gating from mesh.io.a/b/d.valid and restores st_c_addr_start advancement when a looped store request begins.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In ExecuteController, restore the n_a_r_not_v / n_b_r_not_v / n_d_r_not_v predicates on mesh.io.a.valid, mesh.io.b.valid, and mesh.io.d.valid. Optionally also comment out the st_c_addr_start update in LoopMatmul to reproduce the secondary address-regression bug.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Operations that should launch with only a subset of operand channels can stall or fail to feed the array, and looped stores may later reuse the wrong C-address window if the secondary fix is also reverted.
evidence_for_injection: The old valid logic explicitly referenced sibling-channel state instead of only the current channel fire condition and local buffered data.
The patch deletes those sibling-channel predicates without changing payload assembly, indicating a handshake bug rather than a data-format bug.
The same commit reintroduces st_c_addr_start progression, showing there was also a store-control regression in loop state.
notes: For a portable injection dataset, the ExecuteController handshake bug is the cleanest primary target in this mixed commit.
The ext-mem guard changes are real fixes for configuration robustness but are not needed for the main reusable injection case.

zh.summary: 这个混合型回归修复提交里包含一个明确的执行通路错误：mesh 的各个操作数 valid 被错误地受同级通道条件约束，导致不需要全部输入流的操作也可能被阻塞或抑制。提交同时还恢复了循环 store 地址推进，并修正了可选外部存储路径的保护逻辑。
why_it_counts: ExecuteController 和 LoopMatmul 中包含了具体的 DUT 行为修复，而不是测试或文档改动。
mesh valid 门控变更会直接改变阵列何时接收到操作数。
store 地址更新修复了硬件控制状态里循环写回的地址推进。
disqualifiers: 该提交也包含了针对无外部 TL memory writer 配置的 option 处理和连线修复。
多个 bug 被打包在一起，因此最干净的注入目标只能选择补丁中的一部分。
evidence: ExecuteController 从 mesh.io.a.valid、mesh.io.b.valid、mesh.io.d.valid 中删除了 n_a_r_not_v、n_b_r_not_v 和 n_d_r_not_v。
在旧逻辑下，如果某个同级通道未激活但 ready 为真，对应的同级谓词会变成假，从而把当前通道错误地阻塞。
LoopMatmul 在 store 请求发射时重新启用了 st_c_addr_start 的更新。
Scratchpad、Controller 和 AccumulatorMem 为基础配置的 ext-mem 与 TLB 资源加上了 option-aware 防护。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 最主要、也最可复用的错误发生在一个能在同一周期向计算阵列发出多个操作数流的控制器里。错误版本让每个操作数 valid 依赖其他操作数通道的状态，即使这些同级通道对当前操作并不是必需的。这样会把本来独立的输入流错误耦合到同一个握手条件上，在只需要部分操作数移动时抑制合法发射或造成流水线停顿。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 多操作数阵列输入的 valid 生成逻辑
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 某个操作只发射一到两个操作数流，而另一个同级流未激活、为空，或者当前 issue 槽根本不需要它。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 重新把同级通道谓词加入每个操作数 valid，使一个通道只有在不相关的兄弟通道满足额外 ready/valid 条件时才被标记为 valid。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 让每个 valid 依赖兄弟通道状态，而不是只依赖本地 fire 与本地数据可用性
portability_notes: 这类错误可映射到任何有多个独立来源操作数流的 systolic-array、向量单元或融合算子前端。
其架构层面的本质是：让一个操作数流错误地等待另一个在该周期并非语义必需的流。
如果你的 DUT 没有三个通道，也可以在任意两个部分独立的输入通道之间注入同类错误。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到驱动计算阵列或操作数收集器的各路 per-operand valid 组合逻辑。
即使兄弟通道对当前操作并非必需，也把这些兄弟通道的 ready 或缓冲数据状态作为额外谓词加入当前 valid。
保持本地负载数据拼装逻辑不变，使故障表现为发射被抑制或不必要的停顿，而不是来自其他路径的数据损坏。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: ExecuteController 中的 mesh 输入 valid 逻辑，LoopMatmul 的 store 地址推进是同一提交里的次要修复
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复删除了 mesh.io.a/b/d.valid 上的跨通道门控，并恢复了循环 store 开始时的 st_c_addr_start 递增。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 ExecuteController 中，把 n_a_r_not_v / n_b_r_not_v / n_d_r_not_v 谓词重新加回 mesh.io.a.valid、mesh.io.b.valid 和 mesh.io.d.valid。若要复现次级地址回归，也可再次注释掉 LoopMatmul 中 st_c_addr_start 的更新。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 本应只依赖部分操作数通道就能发射的操作会停顿或无法向阵列送数；如果同时回退次级修复，循环 store 还可能复用错误的 C 地址窗口。
evidence_for_injection: 旧版 valid 逻辑显式引用了兄弟通道状态，而不是只依赖当前通道 fire 条件和本地缓冲数据。
补丁删除这些同级谓词时并未改动负载拼装逻辑，说明错误是握手问题而不是数据格式问题。
同一提交还恢复了 st_c_addr_start 的推进，说明循环状态机里也存在 store 控制回归。
notes: 对于可移植的注入数据集，这个混合提交里最干净的主注入目标是 ExecuteController 的握手错误。
ext-mem 保护逻辑的改动虽然也是真实修复，但不是主要的可复用注入场景。
